name: What documentation or information do I need to gather before discussing energy-efficient upgrades with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What documentation or information do I need to gather before discussing energy-efficient upgrades with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before discussing energy-efficient upgrades, it's helpful to gather any recent utility bills to establish a baseline of your current energy consumption. Additionally, consider any specific areas of your home where you notice comfort issues, such as drafts or uneven temperatures. If available, architectural plans can also be useful. This information helps us understand your existing home's performance and allows our team to tailor recommendations for improvements that align with your renovation goals and provide the most impactful energy savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather recent utility bills, note any comfort issues in your home, and have architectural plans ready to help us understand your energy consumption and tailor upgrade recommendations.
